definition: the hearer's finding of the speaker's mistake was for the speaker's good
expansion: (situation benefit (CONTENT (situation find PERFECTIVE (ACTOR (term INTERLOCUTOR)) (UNDERGOER (term mistake GIVEN)))) (RECIPIENT (term SELF)))
pragmatic conditions: after the hearer corrected a position of the speaker's own
constructed history: Constructed history: an agent whose mistake another had found said only that it had been found, and the saying came to thank the finder.
